resources.string: Back up your photos and videos to your private Storage Box.
Enter your Storage Box password once. PiffBackup will install a dedicated key, then erase the password without saving it.
Dedicated key verified for %1$s. Existing backup folder %2$s was found without changing it.
PiffBackup will stop if this server identity changes. You can compare it with the fingerprint shown by Hetzner.
Verifying the key and existing backup folder…
Check the username, server address, and password.
Couldn’t reach the Storage Box. In Hetzner Console, enable SSH Support and External Reachability, wait a few minutes, then retry.
The Storage Box rejected that username or password. Check them and retry.
The server identity changed. PiffBackup stopped to protect your backup. Verify the fingerprint in Hetzner Console before changing this connection.
The password worked, but the dedicated key could not be installed. Retry after confirming SSH Support is enabled.
The dedicated key could not reconnect securely. No backup was started.
Connected securely, but the existing Bianca folder was not found. Nothing was created or changed.
The protected connection could not be saved on this device. No backup was started.
